introduction: Follow the Quintaragon family’s loss through their haunted castle, recover the necklace and Povtail’s diamond-studded bone, and return each to Remy.
orientation: A barely visible path in the Darkmore Forest leads north to the castle entrance. Tev is declared holding the castle key for the north gate; the forward gate also permits ordinary PICK attempts.

The foyer’s maps and portraits describe the family. In the first-floor library, Juku holds the key for the basement trapdoor. Giauque’s ghost in the basement study carries the key for the library’s upper stairwell.
Remy waits in the chief’s office on the second floor. Ask hi, hello, quest or revenge about the stolen necklace. Ask gilman for the separate lead about Povtail.
The LARGE rat in the second-floor storage area carries the holy key. Beyond the holy-room door, Cetyla holds the key for the stairwell to the third floor.

Povtail’s dog house is off the sorcerer’s practice rooms on the third floor. Povtail holds the exact diamond-studded bone accepted by Remy. The bone hand-in can be completed independently of the necklace.
Glynn’s ghost in the madam’s study wears the fourth-floor key at her neck. It opens the route to Gilman’s practice area; Gilman holds the separate key to the sky route.

Llamanby, the Red Megadragon, is declared wearing the Quintaragon family necklace in the sky. Those sky rooms have no ground; prepare suitable support and check current conditions before following the route.
Bring the exact family necklace loose to Remy for the blue sword of revenge. Bring the exact diamond-studded bone loose for the flaming orb of revenge. Supplied exact items also fit either request.

The castle key has no break roll. The basement, second-floor, holy-room, third-floor, fourth-floor, sky and secret-closet keys each have a 100 percent break roll after a successful keyed unlock. Check current doors before returning.

Povtail’s other key opens the secret closet north of a sorcerer’s practice room. The bookcase inside uses the small key declared on Hildebrand, Glynn’s follower; this is an optional branch outside Remy’s hand-ins.

The early bookcases use the castle key. The cracked eggs in the kitchen are props, and the selected cook has no egg request. Room clues can explain the setting without creating another quest completion.
The rune stone and castle memory declared on Llamanby have separate uses. Recovering them, using a stone, visiting a teacher or completing an exchange elsewhere does not complete either Remy hand-in.

Remy stays after either exchange. Both requests are potential daily candidates after discovery, subject to reviewed policy, accessible telemetry, level and faction qualification, party context and native stock, reset and reward availability; a new day does not replenish the castle by itself.

New discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting. Current loose materials show preparation; accepted hand-ins remain recorded after the items are gone.
